bio: The restaurant’s name is inspired by a chanson song. Inside, red bench seating, French movie posters and chanson playing in the background all recreate the feel of a Paris bistro. The menu is an assemblage of French village fare. Each plateful serves two, encouraging sharing. With an extensive list of wines from every region of France, many available by the glass, you can delight in the experience of pairing your dish with wines of the same region....
